sn42.2:1.1: Ekam samayam Bhagavā Rājagahe viharati Veḷuvane Kalandakanivāpe || || 2
sn42.2:1.2: Atha kho Talapuṭo naṭagāmani yena Bhagavā tenupasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantam abhivādetvā ekam antaṃ nisīdi || || 3 Ekam antaṃ nisinno kho Talapuṭo naṭagāmaṇi Bhagavantam etad avoca || ||
sn42.2:1.3: Sutam me tam bhante pubbakānam ācariyapācariyānam naṭānam bhāsamānānaṃ
sn42.2:1.4: Yo so naṭo raṅgamajjhe samajjamajjhe saccālikena janaṃ hāseti rameti || so kāyassa bhedā param maraṇā Pahāsānaṃ devānaṃ sahavyatam upapajjatīti ||
sn42.2:1.6: Alaṃ gāmani tiṭṭhatetam mā mam etam pucchīti || || 4
sn42.2:1.7: Dutiyam pi kho Talapuṭo naṭagāmaṇi Bhagavantam etad avoca || ||
sn42.2:1.8: Sutam me tam bhante pubbakānam ācariyapācariyānaṃ naṭānam bhāsamānānam
sn42.2:1.9: Yo so naṭo raṅgamajjhe samajjamajjhe saccālikena janaṃ hāseti rameti || so kāyassa bhedā param maraṇā Pahāsānaṃ devānam sahavyatam upapajjatīti ||
sn42.2:1.11: Alam gāmaṇi tiṭṭhatetaṃ mā mam etam pucchīti || || 5
sn42.2:1.12: Tatiyam pi kho Talapuṭo naṭagāmaṇi Bhagavantam etad avoca || ||
sn42.2:1.13: Sutam me tam bhante pubbakānam ācariyapācariyānaṃ naṭānam bhāsamānānaṃ
sn42.2:1.14: Yo so naṭo raṅgamajjhe samajjamajjhe saccālikena janaṃ hāseti rameti || so kāyassa bhedā param maraṇā Pahāsānaṃ devānam sahavyatam upapajjatīti ||
sn42.2:2.5: Pubbe kho gāmaṇi sattā avītarāgā rāgabandhanabaddhā ||
sn42.2:2.6: tesaṃ naṭo raṅgamajjhe samajjamajjhe ye dhammā rajaniyā te upasaṃharati bhiyyosomattāya sarāgāya ||
sn42.2:2.7: Pubbe kho gāmaṇi sattā avītadosā dosabandhanabaddhā ||
sn42.2:2.8: tesaṃ naṭo raṅgamajjhe samajjamajjhe ye dhammā dosaniyā te upasaṃharati bhiyyosomattāya sadosāya || ||
sn42.2:2.9: Pubbe kho gāmaṇi sattā avītamohā mohabandhanabaddhā ||
sn42.2:2.10: tesaṃ naṭo raṅgamajjhe samajjamajjhe ye dhammā mohaniyā te upasaṃharati bhiyyosomattāya samohāya || || 7
sn42.2:2.11: So attanā matto pamatto pare madetvā pamādetvā kāyassa bhedā param maraṇā Pahāso nāma nirayo tattha upapajjati || ||
sn42.2:2.12: Sace kho panassa evaṃ diṭṭhi hoti ||
sn42.2:2.13: Yo so naṭo raṅgamajjhe samajjamajjhe saccālikena janaṃ hāseti rameti || so kāyassa bhedā param maraṇā Pahāsānaṃ devānaṃ sahavyatam upapajjatīti || sāssa hoti micchādiṭṭhi || ||
sn42.2:2.14: Micchādiṭṭhikassa kho panāhaṃ gāmaṇi purisapuggalassa dvinnaṃ gatīnam aññataraṃ gatiṃ vadāmi
sn42.2:3.1: Evaṃ vutte Talapuṭo naṭagamaṇi parodi assūni pavattesi || ||
sn42.2:3.3: Alam gāmaṇi tiṭṭhatetam mā mam etam pucchīti || ||
sn42.2:3.4: Nāham bhante etam rodāmi yam mam Bhagavā evamāha ||
sn42.2:3.5: api cāham bhante pubbakehi ācariyapācariyehi naṭehi dīgharattam nikato vañcito paluddho
sn42.2:3.6: Yo so naṭo raṅgamajjhe samajjamajjhe saccālikena janaṃ hāseti rameti || so kāyassa bhedā param maraṇā Pahāsānaṃ devānam sahavyatam upapajjatīti || || 9
sn42.2:3.8: seyyathāpi bhante nikujjitaṃ vā ukkujjeyya || paṭicchannaṃ vā vivareyya mūḷhassa vā maggam ācikkheyya || andhakāre vā telapajjotaṃ kareyya || cakkhumanto rūpāni dakkhanti || evam evam Bhagavatā anekapariyāyena dhammo pakāsito || ||
sn42.2:3.9: Esāham bhante Bhagavantam saraṇaṃ gacchāmi dhammañca bhikkhusaṅghañca ||
sn42.2:3.10: Labheyyāham bhante Bhagavato santike pabbajam labheyyam upasampadanti || || 10
sn42.2:3.11: Alattha kho Talapuṭo naṭagāmaṇi Bhagavato santike pabbajam alattha upasampadaṃ || || 11
